    Ai = A0[:]
    prefix_sum = sum(Ai)
    
    # If the initial prefix sum is already greater than or equal to k, return 0
    if prefix_sum >= k:
        return 0
    
    i = 1
    while True:
        # Calculate the new array A^(i) by subtracting 1 from each element of A^(i-1)
        new_Ai = [x - 1 for x in Ai]
        
        # Update the prefix sum
        prefix_sum += sum(new_Ai)
        
        # Check if the prefix sum is now greater than or equal to k
        if prefix_sum >= k:
            return i
        
        # Update Ai to the new array
        Ai = new_Ai
        i += 1
